item.title: Rav Yosef Messas: Somersaults in Halacha for the Sake of Love | Our Hakhamim
item.description:
Rav Yosef Messas of Meknes, Tlemcen and Haifa was a great posek of remarkable self-confidence. The class looks at his rulings on Shabbat-breaking butchers, carrying, hair covering and wine of non-Jews, Rav Ovadia Yosef's strong disagreement, and his love for every Jew.

item.title: Rav Haim David HaLevi: A Gentle Posek for Changing Times | Our Hakhamim
item.description:
Rav Haim David HaLevi, from a hazan's son to Chief Rabbi of Rishon LeSion and Tel Aviv. His link to Rav Uziel, where they differed, his responsa on lost property, childbirth, fragrance, women's learning and eclipses, and his care for every person.
